name: Cavriago (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cavriago (a yellow lion on red within a blue border) with the inscription COMUNE DI CAVRIAGO in grey arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Cavriago, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cavriago arms — yellow lion on red within a blue border, crowned
inscription COMUNE DI CAVRIAGO arched above the arms
